description:
Verso: Fragment of official correspondence. Mentions [...] al-bilādī(?), [...] al-maḥrūsa, the phrase "it has been validated(?) for some of the Maghribīs" (وان بعض المغاربة قد اصح(؟) لهم). The bottom line mentions "al-mamlūk" (the sender) and possibly the phrase "سودان دمسيه" but it's unclear what دمسيه could mean.

Recto, right page: accounts in Arabic script and Greek/Coptic numerals, organized by day of the week. These may continue in the margin of verso.

Recto, left page: fragment of a letter in Arabic script, at 90 degrees compared to the accounts.
description_he: בלוקי טקסט בכתב ערבי בין שורות המסמך בצד הפנימי, בשוליים ובגב.
